notes.text: Author heading 24, scan 050, read 2026-11-20. The opening paragraph asserts factorization of every generisation morphism into morphisms of gap 1 and gives delta factorial as the number of such factorizations up to isomorphism. The page then writes two modular inclusions, (57) and (58), and defines Gamma-exclamation as the kernel of the marked-point permutation action in (59). The final paragraph asserts a correspondence between the inserted 2-to-the-mu generisations of the graph and the indicated closed, proper and smooth submultiplicities containing its modular stratum, with parenthetical variants. These statements were transcribed as background; no independent mathematical proof check was undertaken. Local ink supports générisation(s) in all four places, singular inclusion, unpunctuated nb, and doubled Z. The underbrace annotation in (58) remains uncertain in both letter identity and cancellation scope. The pale footer reads 49, but its hand is undetermined.
